decision: Case studies as a numbered list with one pitch each
why: Three products don't need a masonry grid; the pitch is the content.

decision: Every case study links to running software, not images
why: Interaction and failure handling are the work; screenshots hide both.
value: Reviewers can break things and see the designed response.

decision: Seeded synthetic data shared by UI, tests and the database
why: Demos, screenshots and tests must show the same numbers every time.

decision: AI is simulated behind the same provider interface a live model would use
why: The trust UX can be judged without API keys or cost.
value: Switching to live is configuration, not a rewrite.
